transcript.text: Thank you both for flagging these issues. Dev, the platform access certificate constraints are critical — the rolling dolly and 45 personnel both violate the hard limits of no rolling dolly and a 35-person cap. Hana, the permit discrepancies are equally serious — we're required to use a battery-silent generator, not the conventional portable one in the draft, and our street closure window is only 11 PM to 1 AM, not 9 PM to 3 AM. Given that the current draft violates the platform access certificate on two counts and the municipal permit on two counts, I cannot approve this plan as written. We need a revised logistics plan that replaces the rolling dolly with an approved alternative, caps platform personnel at 35, switches to a battery-silent generator, and adjusts the street closure to 11 PM–1 AM. I'd like to hear from anyone else before I make a final decision — are there any other concerns or constraints we haven't heard yet?
